buttons.primary: Gradient background (#4B286D to #6C3FA8), 12px border-radius, bold typography, subtle drop shadow, translateY(-2px) hover transition.
buttons.secondary: Glass surface (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), 1px subtle line border, flex gap with icon.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, hover background tint, active scale(0.98).

Social proof trust banner (ratings / user count)
